title: Shore Forest Campground

services.name: Rental Cabins
services.desc: Our rental cabins offer a comfortable way to enjoy camping without the hassle. Tucked into a wooded setting, they provide a cozy place to relax while still being close to all the campground amenities and outdoor fun. Enjoy our “Little Cabins in the Woods”! Each cabin includes comfortable sleeping for up to 4 people in a full size bed and two twin sized bunk beds. Pillows are provided; you will need to bring your own sheets and blankets. There are basic amenities which include a table with bench seats, a kitchen counter with hot & cold running water, small fridge, microwave, toaster, coffee maker, ceiling fan, and a heater.
